stories.title: North Wales and North West police commissioners unite against plans for regional forces
stories.summary: North Wales Police and Crime Commissioner Andy Dunbobbin has joined four commissioners from the North West of England in opposing plans to merge police forces into a small number of regional mega-forces. stories.title: Almost 50,000 Flintshire homes to get £100 energy payment
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council will contact the 49,706 households in council tax bands A-D directly once the one-off payment is available, expected in the new year.

stories.title: Just 40 Flintshire homes had free energy upgrades under Wales’s flagship fuel poverty scheme
stories.summary: Forty homes in Flintshire had free energy efficiency upgrades under the Welsh Government’s Warm Homes Nest scheme last year, new figures show. Across Wales, 1,436 homes received a home energy improvement package between April 2025 and March 2026, the first full year of the scheme’s new contract. stories.title: Welsh house prices rise 1.6 per cent as UK prices fall, Lloyds index shows
stories.summary: House prices in Wales rose by 1.6 per cent over the past year while prices across the UK fell, according to the latest Lloyds House Price Index. The typical property in Wales is now valued at £233,116, Lloyds said. Across the UK, prices fell by 0.6 per cent in October, taking the average to £296,285.

stories.title: Families on Universal Credit urged to register for Year 7 and 8 free school meals
stories.summary: Families on Universal Credit with children in Year 7 or Year 8 can now get free school meals for them, however much the household earns.
